label: Every GOD_4 loves every being in act in esse in the non-passional q.20 sense
paraphrase: Analyst formulation, attribution deferred. For every GOD_4 g and every x in act in esse (God included when God is in act), g loves x in the thin q.20 sense of willing some good to it. Nothing is asserted about nonexistent possibles, friendship, degree, affection, temporal love, interpersonal relationship or the perfect love of the hiddenness challenge. It does not assert that a GOD_4 exists.
